**Technology** – SAP S/4HANA, EWM, TM, Business AI, LeanIX, Signavio, Cloud ALM  

**Location** - Sweden  

  

**Job Description**  

Today, the corporate landscape is dynamic, and the world ahead is full of possibilities! None of the amazing things we do at Infosys would be possible without an equally amazing culture, the environment where ideas can flourish and where you are empowered to move forward as far as your ideas will take you.  

  

At Infosys, we assure that your career will never stand still, we will inspire you to build what’s next and we will navigate further together. Our journey of learnability, values and trusted relationships with our clients continue to be the cornerstones of our organization and these values are upheld only because of our people.  

  

**Your Role**  

Infosys is seeking a highly experienced and visionary Senior Principal Technology Architect – SAP to join our growing SAP practice in Europe. This role requires deep SAP technology expertise, thought leadership, and a strong track record of architecting and delivering complex SAP transformation programs.  

As a Principal Technology Architect, you will own solution architecture, lead client engagements, guide delivery teams, and shape the SAP transformation vision for some of Europe’s leading enterprises.  

  

**Key Responsibilities:**  

Architecture & Delivery Leadership  

* Lead the design and governance of SAP solutions across multiple end to end S/4HANA implementations and large scale transformation programs.
* Define and steer architecture vision aligned with client business strategy, SAP roadmap (S/4HANA, BTP, RISE), enterprise standards, and cost considerations.
* Drive project execution from Phase 0 through delivery, across Greenfield, Brownfield, and Hybrid implementations.
* Utilize SAP’s full toolchain for architecture design, implementation, and lifecycle management.


Client Engagement & Advisory  

* Collaborate with business and IT stakeholders to define transformation roadmaps and readiness assessments.
* Act as a trusted advisor to C-suite and senior stakeholders, influencing transformation strategy, de risking complex programs, and shaping value-driven solution architectures.
* Represent Infosys in key client interactions with strong communication and leadership presence.


Pre-Sales & Thought Leadership  

* Lead solution proposals, architecture blueprints, and effort estimations for RFP/RFI cycles.
* Support deal shaping, value proposition development, and architecture governance for large SAP pursuits.
* Contribute to internal knowledge assets, best practices, reference architectures, and quality frameworks.
* Publications, patents, or external thought leadership are considered a strong advantage.


People Leadership  

* Mentor and guide SAP architects and consulting teams across delivery and pre-sales.
* Establish architecture standards, good practices, and quality gates across the SAP service line.
* Foster a culture of technical excellence, collaboration, and continuous learning.


Skill Required:  

* Deep functional (SAP Finance/Manufacturing/Logistics/Sales) or technical skills (ABAP, Integration, Security, Basis) in one or two SAP ERP skills.
* Experience in SAP S/4HANA, EWM, TM, Business AI, LeanIX, Signavio, Cloud ALM
* Hands-on SAP consulting experience.
* Minimum of 4 full lifecycle SAP project implementations.
* Experience in leading teams in SAP projects.
* Exposure to at least two types of S/4HANA projects: Greenfield, Brownfield, or Hybrid.
* Experience in transformation preparation or Phase 0 activities.
* Proficiency in SAP toolchain usage or administration.
* Valid SAP certification in relevant skill areas.
* Strong client-facing skills with the ability to engage middle management effectively.
* Proven ability to build solution proposals and estimate efforts accurately.
* Demonstrated flexibility, team spirit, and a results-driven mindset.

  

**Preferred Qualifications:**  

* Exposure to multiple SAP modules or skill areas within the SAP product portfolio.
* Publications or thought leadership in SAP or industry-specific domains.

  

**About Infosys**
Infosys is a global leader in next-generation digital services and consulting. We enable clients in 59 countries to navigate their digital transformation.


With over four decades of experience in managing the systems and workings of global enterprises, we expertly steer clients, in 59 countries, as they navigate their digital transformation powered by cloud and AI. We enable them with an AI-first core, empower the business with agile digital at scale and drive continuous improvement with always-on learning through the transfer of digital skills, expertise, and ideas from our innovation ecosystem. We are deeply committed to being a well-governed, environmentally sustainable organization where diverse talent thrives in an inclusive workplace.

title: AI Platform Engineer
description:
Join the Revolution in Commercial Vehicle Tech at Coretura! Our AI Lab builds the shared platform that teams across Coretura use to develop and run AI products safely and reliably. We're looking for a senior software engineer to help design, build and run it. What you’ll do You will work with the AI Lab to set the platform's technical direction, and take on a large share of the hands-on work yourself.
  
  

Together, you'll build the platform that gives teams access to AI models across providers, manages and retrieves the data their AI products rely on, and provides the harnesses agents are built and run in. You'll also build agents yourself, and the observability that shows whether an AI product is giving the right answers, not just whether it's running. Beyond that, your work will include: Security and safety by level: controls and evaluations that scale with how autonomous an AI system is and how safety-critical its use is, from everyday AI tools to autonomous agents, with prompt injection defences built in. The higher the level, the more a system has to prove before release and the more closely it's monitored once live.
  
  

You'll build this together with our Security Hub. Cost and resilience: usage metering built into the platform so teams can see what their AI products consume, and recovery tested for each AI product as a whole (model, knowledge base, prompts and tool integrations), not just the servers it runs on. AI assets as code: prompts, agent definitions, model versions and evaluation datasets, versioned and released through automated pipelines. They change often and any change can shift how a product behaves, so every change is automatically tested, evaluated and traceable before it ships.
  
  

Build to discover, then share what you learn. When we need to know whether an approach works, you build a working version, then use it to help colleagues across Coretura understand what works, what doesn't and why. As a senior engineer, you'll combine those findings with your own experience to help set where the platform goes next. You'll use AI coding agents in your own daily work and help other engineers adopt them safely.
  
  

You'll also review designs and code, mentor the engineers around you, and hand over ownership of components as they're ready for it. You'll report to the AI Lab Lead and work closely with our Digital Architect and the teams behind our developer and data platforms. What you bring A solid background in software engineering, but we care far more about what you've done than how long you've been doing it. You've owned a production system end to end, including its roadmap, incidents and costs, and you've handed parts of it over to other engineers along the way.
  
  

**You're comfortable with:** Using AI coding agents as a normal part of how you write code, with work you can show for it Building AI applications that people can rely on: agents, retrieval (RAG), model APIs and gateways, along with the evaluations that show they behave as intended Defining cloud infrastructure in code and shipping through CI/CD as part of how you build software, with the observability to see how it behaves once it's running Practical security, from least privilege and secrets management to prompt injection defences Writing well-tested, maintainable code in whatever language the problem calls for, and picking up a new one when you need to You look for more efficient ways to build and run things, bring structure to an unclear situation without locking it down too early, and can explain a trade-off so that engineers, security and leadership all understand it. Fluent English is a must. Why Coretura? We're a joint venture between Volvo Group and Daimler Truck, building a shared software platform for the next generation of commercial vehicles.
  
  

We're a young company with very little legacy to work around, backed by two of the world's largest commercial vehicle manufacturers. The AI platform serves teams across the company, so your work will directly affect how they build and ship software. If this sounds like the work you want to do, we look forward to your application. Next steps Ready to build the future of commercial vehicles?
  
  

We review applications on a continuous basis, so don’t wait to submit yours! Last application date: 4th of December 2026. Questions? Don’t hesitate to reach out to Frida Greve, frida.greve@coretura.com if you have any questions regarding the position.
  
  

Please note we do not accept any applications via email. About our recruitment process We are committed to a safe and secure working environment. As a mandatory part of our recruitment process, we carry out drug and alcohol testing and background checks via 2Secure on the final candidate. The background check covers personal details, financial information, company engagements, legal matters, CV verification, media and internet presence, as well as a risk analysis and recommendation.
  
  

A negative drug and alcohol test and an approved background check are required before a formal offer can be made. All checks are carried out in accordance with GDPR, and candidates are always informed in advance. Read more →

title: Data Analyst
description:
#### **Join us to shape the future!**


Teamtailor is a global Employer Branding and ATS SaaS platform used by over 13,000 companies, 250,000 users, and available in 90 countries worldwide.


Working at Teamtailor means being part of a dynamic, fast-paced tech company that values impact and responsibility. Our workplace fosters an environment where everyone can contribute meaningfully to the growth of the company.


Building a diverse team with a wide range of experiences, skills, and backgrounds has always been central to Teamtailor’s mission, and it remains a strength today. We welcome all individuals who share our vision and are committed to contributing to our collective success. Join us in helping companies and people communicate in more meaningful ways to make life-changing decisions together.

#### **About the role!**


We are now looking for a Data Analyst to join our Data & Analytics team, based in Stockholm.


Our Data & Analytics team helps teams across Teamtailor make better, more informed decisions through reliable and accessible data. As a Data Analyst, you'll play a key role in developing and improving our reporting and analytics capabilities, turning complex data into clear, actionable insights that support the business.


We're also strengthening our data foundation and evolving how we approach analytics, so you'll have the opportunity to help shape our next generation of reporting, from improving existing dashboards to building new solutions on top of a scalable, trusted data foundation.


You'll collaborate closely with stakeholders across Sales, Marketing and Customer Success to Product, Finance and People, and report to our Director of Data & Analytics.


This is a great role for someone a few years into their data career, ideally in SaaS, who enjoys both the technical work and the conversations with the people who use it.

#### **Key responsibilities!**

##### **Reporting & Insights**

* Build and maintain dashboards and reports that help teams track performance and make data-driven decisions.
* Turn business questions into clear analyses, and present findings in a way that leads to action.
* Keep our reporting landscape clean: review what exists, retire what's no longer used and document what stays.
* Make sure reporting builds on shared metric definitions, so teams see the same consistent and trusted numbers.
* Help modernize our BI environment, including migrating existing dashboards and developing new reporting solutions.

##### **Enabling the Business**

* Help colleagues self-serve through documentation, training and well-built dashboards.
* Partner with teams across Teamtailor to define and refine the KPIs that matter most to them.
* Proactively spot trends, risks and opportunities in the data and bring them to the right people.
* Work closely with business stakeholders to understand their reporting needs and turn them into scalable, maintainable solutions.

##### **Data Modelling & Quality**

* Contribute to building and improving data models and transformations using SQL and dbt, working closely with the wider data team.
* Spot data quality issues and help fix them at the source rather than in the dashboard.

#### **Requirements!**

##### **Analytical & Business Skills**

* 1 to 3 years of experience in a data analyst, BI developer, or similar role.
* Experience from a SaaS company, with a good grasp of metrics like ARR, churn and pipeline conversion.
* Strong analytical skills and a structured way of breaking down problems.
* Comfortable working with business stakeholders, understanding their needs, and explaining data to people who aren't data experts.
* Excellent communication skills in English, written and spoken.

##### **Technical Skills**

* Solid SQL skills.
* Hands-on experience building and maintaining dashboards and reports in a modern BI tool.
* A keen eye for detail and data quality.
* An understanding of data modelling concepts and how structured datasets support reliable reporting.

##### **Nice to have**

* Experience with dbt or other data modelling and transformation work.
* Experience from cleaning up, migrating or restructuring an existing reporting setup.
* Familiarity with version control (Git).
* Experience working with cloud data warehouses such as BigQuery, Snowflake or similar.

#### **What we offer!**

* The opportunity to work for a leading employer branding and recruitment platform.
* Professional growth in a fast-growing environment, with ongoing training & support.️
* The opportunity to collaborate with a talented and supportive team.

  

If this opportunity excites you, we look forward to receiving your application!

title: Data Engineer
description:
Vill du arbeta med modern datateknik och bygga lösningar som kunderna faktiskt använder? Som Data Engineer på QueensLab bygger du dataplattformar och dataflöden som hjälper våra kunder att få ut mer av sin data. Arbetet sträcker sig från insamling och bearbetning till skalbara lösningar för analys, beslutsstöd och AI.


Hos oss möts teknik, AI och affärsförståelse i lösningar som fungerar i praktiken.

### **Om rollen**


Du arbetar nära kunder och kollegor i tvärfunktionella team där ni designar, bygger och vidareutvecklar datalösningar. Du lägger en stabil grund för analys, maskininlärning och AI-baserade tjänster.

##### **Dataplattformar och dataflöden**

* Designa och bygga skalbara datalösningar utifrån verksamhetens behov.
* Bygga och optimera pipelines som samlar in, transformerar och levererar data, både i realtid och i batch.
* Arbeta med integration, orkestrering och automatisering av dataflöden.
* Bygga lösningar som hanterar stora datamängder effektivt och tillförlitligt.

##### **Data för analys och AI**

* Samarbeta med data scientists, arkitekter och utvecklare kring AI- och ML-lösningar.
* Utforma dataflöden och plattformar som gör data tillgänglig och användbar för analys och maskininlärning.
* Lägga grunden för datadrivna beslut och nya digitala tjänster.

##### **Kvalitet, prestanda och plattformar**

* Se till att data håller hög kvalitet, är tillförlitlig och presterar väl.
* Arbeta med molnplattformar, containerteknik och moderna utvecklingsflöden.
* Bidra till en datainfrastruktur som är robust och säker.
* Utvärdera och införa nya tekniker och arbetssätt.

### **Teknikområden**


Vi arbetar med verktyg och tekniker inom data engineering, moln och DevOps. Några exempel:

* Programmering och databearbetning: Python och SQL.
* Molnplattformar: Azure, AWS och Google Cloud.
* Dataorkestrering och transformation: Databricks, Dagster, dbt och DLT.
* Databearbetning och infrastruktur: Docker, DuckDB och Kubernetes.
* Lagring och datahantering: MinIO, LakeFS och Snowflake.
* DevOps: CI/CD och Infrastructure as Code (IaC).


Vilken teknik vi använder skiljer sig mellan uppdrag och förändras över tid. Du behöver inte kunna hela stacken. Det viktiga är att du har en stabil grund, är nyfiken på nya verktyg och vill fortsätta utvecklas tillsammans med oss.

### **Vem söker vi?**


Du har erfarenhet av data engineering eller angränsande områden och vill bygga tillförlitliga datalösningar. Du arbetar strukturerat och analytiskt och tycker om tekniska utmaningar.

* Erfarenhet av data engineering, dataplattformar eller utveckling av dataintensiva system.
* Goda kunskaper i Python, SQL eller liknande tekniker för databearbetning.
* Förståelse för dataflöden, datamodellering, transformation och integration.
* Erfarenhet av molnplattformar och verktyg för att hantera data.
* Insikt i datakvalitet, prestanda, skalbarhet och tillförlitlighet.
* Vana att samarbeta med utvecklare, arkitekter, data scientists och kunder.
* Du uttrycker dig väl på svenska och engelska, i tal och skrift.

### **Som person**


Du är analytisk och strukturerad och tycker om att skapa ordning i komplex information. Du tar ansvar för dina lösningar, är nyfiken på ny teknik och letar efter enklare sätt att lösa problem.


Du trivs i samarbete med andra och delar gärna med dig av det du kan. Du är kvalitetsmedveten och pragmatisk. För dig är tillförlitlighet och kundnytta lika viktiga som själva tekniken.

### **Därför QueensLab**


Hos QueensLab arbetar du med modern teknik i uppdrag där data, AI och digital utveckling möts. Du får påverka tekniska lösningar, testa nya verktyg och arbeta med kompetenta kollegor.


Vi uppmuntrar kunskapsdelning och nya idéer. AI är en naturlig del av hur vi arbetar, både i vår egen verksamhet och i det vi bygger åt våra kunder.


Vill du bygga datalösningar tillsammans med oss? Vi ser fram emot att höra från dig.

### **Praktiskt**

**Placering**: Göteborg eller Stockholm

**Start**: Efter överenskommelse

**Omfattning**: Heltid

**Anställningsform**: Tillsvidareanställning

**Ansök senast**: Löpande urval

title: SAP Data Strategist - Sweden
description:
**Role –** SAP Data Strategist  

**Technology –** SAP Data Strategy  

**Location –** Sweden  

  

Why Infosys  

Join Infosys and be part of a forward-thinking, open, and globally diverse organization. We foster innovation over repetitive work and growth over stagnation. As one of the fastest-growing SAP consulting organizations in Germany and Europe, Infosys offers compelling career opportunities in a dynamic, high-impact environment.  

You will collaborate with highly skilled professionals in a global corporate culture and play a leading role in large-scale digital transformation programs for DAX 30 and Fortune 1000 clients. Our growth trajectory provides you with the opportunity to lead global teams and shape enterprise-wide transformation journeys.

Are you a seasoned SAP professional with deep experience in enterprise transformation and global deployments? Do you want to operate at a larger scale and influence end-to-end business transformation? This role offers the opportunity to shape future-ready enterprise solutions through high-impact S/4HANA programs.  

As a Senior Industry Principal / Solution Architect, you will engage across the full transformation lifecycle, collaborating closely with business and IT leaders to define, design, and deliver data-driven, value-focused solutions.

* Generate consulting-led opportunities and thought leadership with key clients
* Co-create next-generation business models and end-to-end processes to drive competitive advantage and cost leadership

* Mentor, guide, and develop team members across geographies
* Act as a hands-on, approachable, and reliable leader
* Ensure solution quality, transparent feedback, and delivery excellence
* Represent Infosys as a trusted advisor to senior client stakeholders
* Bring best-in-class industry practices, data metrics, and multiple solution options to enable informed decision-making

Required Knowledge & Skills  

* Enterprise data design expertise: CDM, LDM, PDM, data standardization and harmonization
* Data-driven organization design, including data governance frameworks, roles, and operating models
* Data platform selection and architecture for aggregation, analytics, reporting, and monetization
* Strong familiarity with the SAP product portfolio and SAP consulting landscape
* Deep functional expertise (Finance & Controlling / Manufacturing / Logistics / Sales) or technical expertise (ABAP, UI5, Integration, Security, Basis)
* Strong IT and SAP architecture knowledge
* Business acumen across industries, value chains, financial metrics, and emerging trends
* Proven C-level and senior stakeholder engagement capabilities
* Extensive experience in IT-enabled transformation and operations
* 14+ years of hands-on SAP consulting experience
* Participation in at least 5 end-to-end SAP implementations (new offerings)
* Experience as Architect or Program/Track Lead
* Exposure to at least two project types: Greenfield, Brownfield, or Hybrid
* Transformation preparation / Phase 0 experience
* SAP toolchain usage or administration experience
* Valid SAP certification(s)
* Strong client-facing presence, communication, and presentation skills
* Solution proposal development and estimation expertise
* Ability to multitask, work collaboratively, and lead with a winning mindset

  

Preferred Skills  

* Exposure across multiple SAP modules and domains
* Experience in SAP Sales and Service Delivery roles
* Prior business-domain experience before IT
* External publications or thought leadership in relevant domains
* Exposure to non-SAP platforms (e.g., Salesforce, Microsoft ecosystem)

  

Personal Attributes  

* Strong analytical and lateral thinking abilities
* High levels of proactiveness and leadership maturity
* Passion for customer success and long-term relationships
* Strong drive for excellence and quality
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills

title: ERP Cloud Migration Project Manager
description:
Nordic Investin is recruiting an ERP Cloud Migration Project Manager on behalf of one of our partner companies. You create pace through clarity when workstreams, decisions and dependencies must move as one, and you surface risk early.


The partner is strengthening its capability in ERP cloud migration across applications integrations data and business readiness. You will connect ERP roadmap, data migration and integration while ensuring that testing and cutover receive appropriate discipline. The aim is practical progress that colleagues can use, leaders can evaluate and the organisation can sustain.


Project leadership connects outcomes, plans, risks and decisions. Success is controlled change the organisation can sustain.

### **How you will work**


You will work across business, technology, suppliers and operations. The partner expects shared priorities, visible decisions and an adaptable delivery model.


This role calls for independent judgement and the ability to raise the quality around you. You are expected to make trade-offs visible, recognise when a decision needs wider expertise and move work forward without creating unnecessary process.

### **What you will do**


Own the practical direction for ERP cloud migration across applications integrations data and business readiness.


Translate goals and constraints into a clear approach for ERP roadmap and data migration.


Establish useful standards, routines or decision artefacts around integration.


Coordinate stakeholders and dependencies affecting testing.


Use evidence and measurable outcomes to improve cutover.


Strengthen knowledge sharing and sustainable ownership through stakeholder governance.

### **What you will bring**


Relevant experience delivering ERP cloud migration across applications integrations data and business readiness in a demanding environment.


Strong working knowledge of ERP roadmap and data migration.


Practical experience applying integration and testing.


Ability to assess priorities, risks and trade-offs involving cutover.


Evidence of clear stakeholder communication and dependable end-to-end ownership.


Professional English and the judgement to work with sensitive or business-critical information.


Experience that would add value


Experience from international enterprises and finance transformation.


Exposure to stakeholder governance in a cross-functional or multi-team environment.


Swedish language skills or experience working across Nordic organisations.


A background that can succeed here


Your background may be consulting, a transformation office or complex delivery. Show how you controlled uncertainty and guided difficult decisions. Direct experience of ERP cloud migration across applications integrations data and business readiness is valuable, while adjacent experience counts when it shows transferable judgement.


What makes the opportunity interesting


The assignment offers visible responsibility, access to decision makers and room to shape a purposeful delivery model. The focus on ERP cloud migration across applications integrations data and business readiness gives the opportunity a clear mission and room to influence priorities and success measures.


The exact partner, employment model, compensation, start date and working arrangement will be explained openly during the process. Nordic Investin will make sure you understand the opportunity before asking you to make a decision.


The recruitment conversation


Nordic Investin will focus on decisions you have made: the context, alternatives, result and what you would change today. You will also have room to ask direct questions and test whether the role, mandate and partner environment are right for you.

### **How to apply**


Apply with your CV or LinkedIn profile and a short note about a relevant programme, project or transformation you helped improve. Nordic Investin welcomes different routes into the profession and assesses evidence, judgement and potential alongside formal titles.

title: Systems Engineer
description:
Är du en erfaren systemingenjör som vill arbeta med kravhantering, systemdesign, integration och verifiering av komplexa försvars- och informationssystem?


Vill du vara med och säkerställa att rätt system utvecklas, att krav omsätts till tekniska lösningar och att kravuppfyllnad kan verifieras genom hela systemets livscykel?


Då kan detta vara rätt tjänst för dig.


Hos MilDef arbetar vi med avancerade försvars- och informationssystem där hårdvara, mjukvara, kommunikationslösningar, IT-system och säkerhetsfunktioner samverkar för att skapa robusta lösningar för försvar och samhällskritisk verksamhet.

**Din nya utmaning**


Vi söker Systems Engineers till vårt Requirements & Verification-team i Rosersberg.


Som Systems Engineer arbetar du genom hela systemlivscykeln och bidrar till att säkerställa att projekt utvecklar rätt system, att krav omsätts till verifierbara lösningar och att slutleveransen uppfyller kundens behov.


Rollen omfattar bland annat:

* Kravhantering och kravanalys
* Systems Engineering
* Systemarkitektur och systemdesign
* Systemintegration
* Assurans, spårbarhet och förändringshantering
* Test, verifiering och validering
* Teknisk dokumentation

Du arbetar nära projektledare, utvecklare, testingenjörer och kunder och får en central roll i att skapa struktur, kvalitet och teknisk helhet i våra projekt.

**Huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter**

* Analysera, bryta ned och realisera systemkrav
* Definiera och dokumentera tekniska lösningar
* Säkerställa spårbarhet mellan krav, design, implementation och verifiering
* Utforma verifierings- och valideringsstrategier
* Ta fram verifieringsmatriser, verifieringsplaner och testspecifikationer
* Planera, genomföra och följa upp verifieringsaktiviteter
* Identifiera tekniska risker och avvikelser
* Bidra till utveckling av metoder och arbetssätt inom Requirements & Verification

**Vi söker dig med**

* Högskole- eller civilingenjörsutbildning inom Systems Engineering, datateknik, elektronik eller motsvarande teknisk inriktning alternativt motsvarande arbetslivserfarenhet
* Erfarenhet av arbete med komplexa tekniska system
* Förmåga att analysera tekniska problem och identifiera risker i ett tidigt skede
* Erfarenhet av teknisk dokumentation
* Erfarenhet av tvärfunktionellt arbete i utvecklingsprojekt
* Förståelse för kravhantering, spårbarhet, verifiering och testmetodik

**Meriterande om du har**

* Erfarenhet från försvarsindustrin eller försvarssektorn
* Erfarenhet från NATO-relaterad verksamhet
* Erfarenhet av Systems Engineering enligt ISO 15288
* Erfarenhet av verifiering och validering av komplexa system
* Erfarenhet av systemintegration
* Erfarenhet av kravhanteringsverktyg såsom Qrendo, Teamcenter, IBM DOORS, Polarion, Jama eller liknande
* Erfarenhet av säkerhetskritiska system

**Vem är du?**


Du är analytisk, strukturerad och lösningsorienterad. Du trivs med att förstå komplexa system, skapa struktur i tekniskt arbete och omsätta behov till verifierbara lösningar.


Du har ett starkt ansvarstagande, samarbetar väl med andra teknikdiscipliner och bidrar aktivt till att utveckla både projekt och arbetssätt. Du talar och skriver flytande på svenska och engelska.


Vi söker i första hand dig som har flera års erfarenhet av Systems Engineering eller närliggande roller.


Vi välkomnar även kandidater tidigare i karriären som kombinerar stark teknisk grund med exceptionellt driv, hög lärförmåga och utvecklingspotential.

**Lär känna oss**


På MilDef blir du en del av ett företag som värdesätter praktiskt engagemang, gemenskap och utveckling av ledande försvarsteknik. Hos oss får du möjlighet att utveckla nya färdigheter, bidra i tvärfunktionella projekt och göra en konkret skillnad för vår fortsatta framgång. Vi uppmuntrar kontinuerligt lärande, samarbete, och erbjuder goda möjligheter till karriärutveckling. Vi är stolta över att aktivt främja hälsa och balans mellan arbete och privatliv. Det gör vi bland annat genom att erbjuda attraktiva förmåner samt hälsofrämjande initiativ.


Vill du veta mer om MilDef, våra produkter och vår kultur? Läs mer här MilDef.com


För mer information om rollen, vänligen kontakta HR Olise Andersson

**Viktig information**


Vi genomför drogtester på alla våra framtida kollegor innan anställning.


På grund av verksamhetens karaktär kan anställning, oavsett befattning, förutsätta bakgrunds- och säkerhetsrelaterade kontroller.


Vi arbetar med löpande urval och ser fram emot din ansökan. Under jul- och nyårsperioden kan vår återkoppling ta något längre tid än vanligt.

***MilDef - WE ARMOR IT.***

*MilDef is a global systems integrator and full-spectrum provider specializing in rugged IT for military, government and critical infrastructure sectors. MilDef provides hardware, software, and services that shield and protect critical information streams and systems, when and where the stakes are the highest. MilDef’s products are sold to more than 200 customers through companies in Sweden, Norway, Finland, Denmark, United Kingdom, Germany, Switzerland, the United States and Australia, and through partner networks in more than 40 countries. MilDef was founded in 1997 and is listed on Nasdaq Stockholm since 2021.*
